Great food & service. Could have done with an air-conditioned section
Jun 2020
Non-descript looking place for it is located deep inside a cluster of small shops selling bric brac, but this is one of the two F&B outlets, the other one being serving Thai food.

Snap serves a mixture of Western and Local food, but mainly Western biased. I have been thrice, all three times for breakfast. Breakfast food choices are plentiful and varied. I opted for the full English breakfast, smoked salmon cream cheese bagel and the breakfast burrito respectively. I have to say that on all occasions the food was excellent. Pricing too was reasonable for the quality that you get. And, the Vietnamese coffee is excellent too.

The drawback of this place is that there isn't an air-conditioned section. This means that it could be a little uncomfortable on those hot and humid afternoons. Even worse, it also means the ENTIRE RESTAURANT IS A SMOKING SECTION.

Would I return a 4th time? You bet I would but only for a weekday breakfast when the clientele is sparse and I can find refuge from the smoking public.

A great place to eat and hang out!
May 2020
I was in search of a place where I could spend hours relaxing, working on my laptop, and eating/drinking. It was suggested I try The Snap Cafe. What a fantastic find! It's a restaurant with an amazing area of comfortable couches, chairs, and tables in a very lush, garden setting. There are also a variety of retail shops in the complex. I came in, mid-afternoon and stayed until 7:30. It was just a very nice, relaxing place to spend time especially during these times when we have all been housebound for quite a while. Their menu has a bit of everything and I had difficulty deciding what to order but settled on a parma, olive, and artichoke pizza. Beer on tap is a nice touch! The Pizza was quite good and I'm certain the other dishes would also be good. I will find out because this is now my "go-to" place when I don't want to spend time in my apartment. Even though it's a 45-minute scooter ride from where I live, I'll be happy to take the drive. A friendly, English speaking staff, too!

Wonderful restaurant for families!
Jan 2020
My family and I visited Snap Cafe a couple of times during our visit to HCMC this December and January. Our 6 year old daughter had a wonderful time playing on the equipment and in the sand while my husband and I drank ca phe su das and read. We ordered both breakfast and lunch when we went and everything we ordered was pretty good. The coffee and juices are quite delicious. There are also many shops you can check out while your children happily play on the playground. 

It is true that service is just OK. We had to flag people down to take our order but the food was always delivered quickly and was fresh upon arrival. And once a waiter or waitress was flagged down, they took good care of us. 

I highly recommend coming if you need a little break from the bustle of the city.

Perfect for families with active kids
Oct 2019
My family visited several times during our recent trip to Ho Chi Minh City. We stayed in District 1, but used to live in District 2 and remembered that Snap was a good place for kids. It was a lifesaver - the kids loved the jungle gym, played happily and safely while parents ate and caught up with friends, while keeping an eye on the kids. The staff are friendly, food and drinks are reasonably priced. Food quality isn't great, but it's fine, and the main thing was that it was at least edible, because I needed a place for the kids to run around and play - that was the objective, and Snap was perfect for that.
